## Postings Report

The base of the reports that read each posting over a period of months: `fromMonth`, `toMonth`, a `view` (Report View), the chart, and the postings themselves: the journal months, and the invoices, bills and opening balances still posted as cards. Those load only when the report is read, and the report waits for them.

```ts
import { SalesByCustomer, SalesByItem, ExpensesByVendor, GeneralLedger, PostingsReport } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-report-library';
```

`entries(view)` gives the postings on the view's basis. `cappedNote()` names a source that was read only to its first page of 1,000.

### Example
Sales by Customer, Expenses by Vendor, Sales by Product and General Ledger extend it.
